title: Doozy Vape Co Seriously Pod Fill Blackcurrant Passion  100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Discover a true flavour adventure with Doozy Vape Co's Seriously Pod Fill's Blackcurrant Passion. This e-liquid marries the tart richness of blackcurrants with the exotic sweetness of passionfruit, resulting in a vaping experience that's both balanced and captivating. From the first inhale, the blackcurrant's intense fruitiness sweeps across your taste buds, giving you a satisfying hit of dark, juicy flavour. It's as though you've just popped a handful of freshly-picked blackcurrants into your mouth—every note is incredibly authentic, mimicking the real fruit in both taste and aroma. Just as you're settling into the blackcurrant's delectable tartness, in comes the passionfruit to shake things up. The tropical fruit adds a layer of sweet, aromatic complexity that enhances the blackcurrant without overshadowing it. The result is a beautiful equilibrium of flavours that constantly shifts, keeping you fully engaged with each puff. Discover unparalleled vaping bliss with Doozy Vape Co's Seriously Pod Fills. Boasting ten mouth-watering, double-concentrated flavours, these e-liquids are expertly crafted to tantalise your taste buds while keeping nicotine cravings at bay. Unique in their 50/50 VG/PG blend, Pod Fills are versatile, ideal for Starter Kits , MTL Pod Kits , and devices with coils of 0.8ohm or higher. Enjoy the convenience of a 100ml shortfill bottle, complete with 20ml of extra space for your preferred nicotine shot. For instance, add 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots to create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid.
